name: developer
title: Developer
description: A spec stub, and a commands-and-gotchas section in the runbook.
audience: Technical and direct: lead with the change and why; include file paths, commands and code where they help; note gotchas and what was tested.

farm_tasks.title: Second opinion on a change
farm_tasks.does: Reads a staged diff as a second reader and lists concrete defects it can point to.
farm_tasks.escalate: Unverified by nature: Claude checks every finding before you act on it; anything about security, auth or data loss comes to you first.

farm_tasks.title: Test failure triage
farm_tasks.does: Groups a failing test run's output into distinct problems, with the lines that show each.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude reads the original output when a failure is not clearly explained, or when the engine finds none in a run that failed.

farm_tasks.title: Changelog draft
farm_tasks.does: Drafts changelog bullets from commit subjects and merged-change notes.
farm_tasks.escalate: You edit the wording; Claude steps in if a bullet names a change the commits do not show.

farm_tasks.title: Branch summary
farm_tasks.does: Summarises what a branch changed, in plain sentences for a pull request description.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude checks the summary against the diff before it is posted anywhere.

sections.heading: Commands and gotchas
sections.body: <!-- Build, test and run commands that work, and the traps already met. -->

pane.label: Start my day
pane.prompt: Start my day: show what is waiting for me, what is overdue and what I should do first.

pane.label: Add a task
pane.prompt: I want to add a task. Ask me what it is and which project it belongs to.

pane.label: Plan this change
pane.prompt: Plan the change I am about to make before any code is written.

pane.label: Build the plan
pane.prompt: Implement the approved plan one phase at a time, test first.

pane.label: Run all checks
pane.prompt: Run every check on this repo and tell me how many actually ran.

pane.label: Commit when green
pane.prompt: Commit once the checks pass and a test receipt covers the changes.

pane.label: Save learnings
pane.prompt: Write down what we learned in this session.

pane.label: Write a handoff
pane.prompt: Write a handoff for the next session so nothing is lost.

pane.label: Open a project
pane.prompt: Open a project for me. Ask me which one.

pane.label: Find in my notes
pane.prompt: Look something up in my notes. Ask me what I am looking for.

pane.label: Check gt
pane.prompt: Check that my gt install is healthy.
